before.name: Attack

before.name: Ensnaring Thorns · turn-start
before.description: Actual Ensnaring Strike, failed save and thorn damage on the victim's real turn. Fixture seed 7.

before.name: Cure Wounds
before.description: 1 tile: heals 2d8 + casting modifier

before.name: Ensnaring Strike
before.description: Weapon attack, 8 tiles: weapon damage; Str save (target is Ensnared until saved) — On a hit, thorny vines bind the target: a STR save or restrained, taking 1d6 piercing each turn until it breaks free.

before.name: Entangle
before.description: 6 tiles, burst 1: creates a entangle zone (burst 1) for 10 rounds, difficult terrain, ends if you lose concentration; Str save (target is Restrained until saved)

before.name: Hail of Thorns
before.description: Weapon attack, 8 tiles: weapon damage; Dex save (1d4 piercing; half damage on a save); chains to up to 2 more targets within 1 tile — On a hit, your arrow bursts into thorns: up to two foes make a DEX save against thorns: 1d4 piercing, 1d6 from level 3.

before.name: Hunter's Mark
before.description: 6 tiles: target is Hunted — Hits on a Hunted target deal an extra 1d4 force at levels 1 and 2, then 1d6 from level 3: a game balance progression.

before.name: Hunters Mark Bonus
before.description: Visible passive triggered during Attack; fixture seed 7. Weapon attack, weapon range: weapon damage

before.name: Barkskin
before.description: 1 tile: target is Barkskinned

before.name: Lesser Restoration
before.description: 1 tile: ends poison conditions on target; ends Blinded on target; ends Paralysed on target

before.name: Spike Growth
before.description: 6 tiles, burst 2: creates a spikes zone (burst 2) for 10 rounds, difficult terrain, ends if you lose concentration; units inside: When you enter a tile, on yourself: 2d4 piercing — The ground sprouts hard spikes: difficult terrain, and 2d4 piercing for every tile walked into it.

before.name: Spike Growth · OnEnterTile
before.description: Real engine zone entry hook.

before.name: Conjure Barrage
before.description: Dex save, self, cone 7: 4d8 force; half damage on a save — Game balance: conjured missiles sweep the cone for 4d8 force per creature; a Dexterity save halves the damage.

before.name: Lightning Arrow
before.description: Weapon attack, 8 tiles: 4d8 lightning; on a miss, 2d8 lightning — Your arrow becomes a bolt of lightning: 4d8 lightning on a hit, half as much on a miss.

before.name: Vanish
before.description: Self: you are Hidden for 1 round

before.name: Companion
before.description: Beastmaster: Real OnBattleStart hook; fixture seed 7.

before.name: Sic 'Em
before.description: Beastmaster: 6 tiles: marks target for 2 rounds (your attacks on it have advantage); target is Lit for 1 round

before.name: Pack Bond
before.description: Beastmaster: 6 tiles: heals 1d8 + casting modifier; target gets +2 to attack rolls and +2 weapon damage for 1 round

before.name: Alpha Howl
before.description: Beastmaster: 0 tiles, burst 3: target gains 2d8 + level temporary HP; target gets +1 Move and has advantage on its attack rolls for 2 rounds

before.name: Ferocious Bond
before.description: Beastmaster: Visible passive triggered during Attack; fixture seed 7. Weapon attack, weapon range: weapon damage

before.name: Deadeye Shot
before.description: Sharpshooter: Weapon attack, weapon range: weapon damage + 1d8. With more than one attack, these bonuses and riders apply until the first hit; the rest are plain hits

before.name: High Ground Mastery
before.description: Sharpshooter: Visible passive triggered during Attack; fixture seed 7. Weapon attack, weapon range: weapon damage

before.name: Piercing Shot
before.description: Sharpshooter: Dex save, self, line 6: 3d8 piercing; half damage on a save

before.name: Volley
before.description: Sharpshooter: Weapon attack, 8 tiles, burst 2: weapon damage + 2d8

before.name: Vine Snare
before.description: Warden: Str save, 4 tiles: pulls target up to 2 tiles toward you; target is Restrained for 1 round; 2d6 bludgeoning

before.name: Nature's Veil
before.description: Warden: Self: you gain 1d10 + level temporary HP; you get +2 AC for 1 round

before.name: Guardian of the Grove
before.description: Warden: 0 tiles, burst 2: creates a entangle zone (burst 2) for 3 rounds, difficult terrain; target gains 3d8 + level temporary HP; target gets +2 AC for 2 rounds
